name: The Guneku Integrated Health Centres
description: Three Integrated Health Centres serve the outlying quarters of Guneku. The Palace and GUDECA assessed all three, and the assessment was filmed as a documentary series. The statuses below are from that assessment and may have changed since.

facilities.name: Munam Integrated Health Centre
facilities.detail: A government structure offering general consultations, admission of patients, deliveries and treatment of minor health problems. It serves Munam and the neighbouring village of Sang, and remained functional throughout the crisis years. The USA branch of GUDECA recruited and posted an additional nurse in December 2020 on a renewable three-year contract, adding to the four already there.

facilities.name: Mbengeghang Integrated Health Centre
facilities.detail: Operating with no electricity supply; a bush lamp is the light source when patients are attended to at night.

facilities.name: Fringyeng Integrated Health Centre
facilities.status: Built, not yet reported as operational
facilities.detail: The assessment found it constructed but not yet in service. In September 2022 the Fon wrote of a newly established healthcare centre in Fringyeng and warned against interfering with it; its present state needs to be confirmed.

films.subject: Mbengeghang and Fringyeng Integrated Health Centres

sourceNote: Recorded 2026-09-02 from the Palace and GUDECA health assessment documented by Mbengwi Online, and from the December 2020 report of the GUDECA USA nurse posting. Episode dates were not captured in the source material, and the present status of each centre is not established.
